description: An oil-style night scene of a vintage steam-era machine on a wooden platform, with a tall pipe rising from a pump or engine with a flywheel, a valve on a side pipe, and white steam billowing around it. Four or five men in dark suits and fedora or bowler hats stand around, under a string of glowing incandescent bulbs, with torches at the edges and steam plumes rising from a dark hillside behind. There is no visible text, signature, frame or border, and the painting fills the image edge to edge. Nothing is gory or nude.
